about_item: [Sensory Fidget Toys] Three adorable designs (caterpillar, crocodile, school bus) keep 12-18 months toddlers hooked for hours as they push bubbles and restart the fun. In addition to being pressable, the bubbles on this toy are flipable. You can turn the toy over and start popping the bubbles from the other side, doubling the fun and providing more ways to play. This unique feature extends the entertainment value of the toy.

[Early Montessori Toys] The pressable bubbles on this toy offer a wonderful sensory experience for little ones. As toddlers press the bubbles, they feel the satisfying pop and hear the gentle sound, stimulating their tactile and auditory senses, which is crucial for their early development. Great toys for classroom, restaurant, car ride, party, etc.

[Baby Toddler Travel Essential] Ultra-lightweight and travel-friendly—perfect for airplane, car road trips, church, restaurant. With flipable bubbles, this toy provides twice the fun, keeping them entertained for longer periods. Fits in diaper bags to rescue parents from meltdowns anytime, anywhere.

[Popits Fidget Toy for Babies] Made with unbreakable ABS plastic and soft silicone bubbles. It can withstand continuous pressing and flipping without easily getting damaged, ensuring long - term use and value for your money. Extra-thick and large design prevents choking hazards, while smooth edges protect tiny hands. 100% non-toxic & worry-free.

[Christmas Stocking Stuffer Gift for Baby Toddler] This pack of popit toy definitely would be a great choice as a birthday gift, Valentine Day's gift, gift bag filler, Christmas stocking stuffers, classroom prize, travel partner and Easter Basket Stuffers Easter basket filler for toddlers 12+ month and babies.
